paragraphs: Finding constraints is part of the E/R modeling process. Commonly used constraints are:
Keys: Implicit constraints on uniqueness of entities
Ex: An SSN uniquely identifies a person
Ex: a person can have only one father
Referential integrity constraints: Referenced entities must exist
Ex: if you work for a company, it must exist in the database
Ex: peoples’ ages are between 0 and 150

paragraphs: A weak entity is an entity whose instances cannot exist in the  database without the existence of an instance of another entity
Any entity that is not weak entity is called a strong entity

The weak entity’s identifier is a combination of the identifier of the  owner entity and the partial key of the weak entity.
